findings.title: Substring matching can upsample unrelated Discover queries
findings.body: This checks whether the raw query contains `event.type:error`, not whether that is an actual filter. A query matching that text inside a message or tag value—or a mixed query that also selects transactions—will still replace `count()` with `sum(sample_weight)`. The response then reports weighted counts for rows that are not exclusively errors. Parse the query and verify its event-type constraints before enabling the transformation.

findings.title: Upsampling eligibility uses the original dataset during widget splits
findings.body: For a split dashboard widget, `_get_event_stats` can be called with `scoped_dataset=discover` for the error-events query while the captured `dataset` remains the original metrics dataset. Passing that original dataset here makes the helper reject upsampling for non-Discover/non-errors datasets, so the split error count remains an unweighted `count()` and undercounts sampled errors. Check eligibility against the scoped dataset and the query actually being executed.
